checks.text: Pasting `|A|B|C|\n|---|---|---|\n|1|2|3|` shows three rows: "A, B, C" and "1, 2, 3".
Pasting `|X|Y|\n|---|---|\n|a|b|` shows two rows: "X, Y" and "a, b".
Pasting an empty string shows no output.
Pasting `|A|B|\n|---|---|\n|C|D|` shows two rows: "A, B" and "C, D".
Pasting `|X|Y|Z|\n|---|---|---|\n|1|2|3|` shows one row: "X, Y, Z" and another: "1, 2, 3".
Pasting `|A|B|\n|---|---|\n|C|D|` with a trailing newline shows two rows: "A, B" and "C, D".
Pasting `|A|B|\n|---|---|\n|C|D|` with extra spaces in cells shows "A, B" and "C, D".
Reload keeps the input text and output table visible.
